record.question: A hall is 15 m long and 12 m broad. If the sum of the areas of the floor and the ceiling is equal to the sum of the areas of four walls, the volume of the hall is:
record.explanation: Floor plus ceiling is 2×15×12=360 m². Four walls are 2(15+12)h=54h, so h=20/3 m and volume 15×12×20/3=1,200 m³.
